JournalPruned.description:
A person prunes the entries of a trigger's journal written before a time, with
`priory journal prune`. Every runner applies it in log order, unless it names no person.

before.description: Entries written before this time go.

person.description: The person who ran `priory journal prune`.

trigger.description: The trigger whose journal it prunes.
